package_goal: minimal frozen recomputation package; not a repository dump and not a human-adjudication rerun
current_blockers: No rights-holder-selected external redistribution license exists for the Paper1 method source.
No anonymized package snapshot has passed the required license, privacy, inventory, and clean-extraction reviews.
The selected canonical final archive must pass its provider-free integrity validation before any output snapshot can be packaged.

future_components.role: Exact runtime revision with upstream license notice.
Allowlisted Paper1 method release with explicit redistribution authorization.
Evaluator and schemas that recompute paper-facing statistics without providers.
Only manifest-bound input assets needed for the claimed output scope.
Final outputs and sanitized human decision snapshot needed for arithmetic recomputation.

excluded_components: judge/ and any Judge or adjudicator code
reviewer identities, assignments, and unblinding mappings
LLM records, provider request/response streams, credentials, and caches
human_adjudication_boundary: The human Judge process is never externally distributed or rerun. Final human decisions may be copied only as frozen, non-executable output data for arithmetic recomputation; the package must not claim to reproduce human adjudication.
